nodes.summary: For sequences $a, b \colon \mathbb{N} \to R$ in a commutative ring $R$ and indices $i, j \in \mathbb{N}$ (counted from zero), the Hurwitz entry $h_{ij}$ is $0$ if $i \ge 2j + 2$; otherwise it is $a_{j - i/2}$ if $i$ is even and $b_{j - (i-1)/2}$ if $i$ is odd.
nodes.title: Entries of the Hurwitz matrix

nodes.summary: For sequences $a, b \colon \mathbb{N} \to R$ in a commutative ring $R$ and $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the Hurwitz matrix of order $n$ is the $(n+1) \times (n+1)$ matrix whose entry in row $i$ and column $j$, for $0 \le i, j \le n$, is the Hurwitz entry $h_{ij}$ of $a$ and $b$.
nodes.title: Hurwitz matrix

nodes.summary: For a sequence $a \colon \mathbb{N} \to R$ in a commutative ring $R$, its Hurwitz transform is the Hurwitz transform of $a$ and the sequence $(0^k)_{k \in \mathbb{N}}$, which is $1$ at $k = 0$ and $0$ for $k \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Hurwitz transform of a single sequence

nodes.summary: For sequences $a, b \colon \mathbb{N} \to R$ in a commutative ring $R$, the Hurwitz transform of $a$ and $b$ is the sequence whose $n$-th term, for $n \in \mathbb{N}$, is the determinant of the Hurwitz matrix of $a$ and $b$ of order $n$.
nodes.title: Hurwitz transform

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
